title: ORIGINS: A protein network-based approach to quantify cell pluripotency from scRNA-seq data
author: Senra, Guisoni, et al.

steps.title: Download UMI count matrix
steps.instruction: Obtain the raw UMI count matrix for the scRNA‑seq dataset and load it into the R environment.

steps.title: Filter cells and features
steps.instruction: Apply quality‑control filters to remove low‑quality cells and uninformative genes.

substeps.instruction: Remove cells with unique feature (gene) counts > 3000 or < 200.
Discard cells with total mapped reads < 12 000.
Exclude cells whose mitochondrial gene expression exceeds 5 % of total counts.
Filter out genes (features) that are detected in fewer than 3 cells.
Delete three small non‑epithelial clusters identified as stromal, endothelial, and outlier cells.

steps.title: Normalize gene expression data
steps.instruction: Normalize raw counts to make cells comparable.

substeps.instruction: For each cell, divide gene counts by the total counts for that cell.
Multiply the resulting values by a scale factor (default Seurat scale factor).
Apply natural‑log transformation to the scaled values.
Execute the NormalizeData() function from the Seurat R package.

steps.title: Identify highly variable features
steps.instruction: Detect genes that show high cell‑to‑cell variation using Seurat's variable‑feature selection routine.

steps.title: Scale data for dimensionality reduction
steps.instruction: Standardize the normalized expression matrix so that each gene has mean 0 and variance 1 across cells.

steps.title: Perform PCA and UMAP
steps.instruction: Reduce dimensionality of the scaled data and visualize it.

substeps.instruction: Run principal component analysis (PCA) on the scaled matrix.
Run Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection (UMAP) on the PCA results.
Generate visualizations of the PCA and UMAP embeddings.

steps.title: Cluster cells with Seurat
steps.instruction: Group cells into clusters based on their reduced‑dimensional representation.

substeps.instruction: Use FindNeighbors() to construct a K‑nearest‑neighbors graph in PCA space using Euclidean distance.
Apply FindClusters() which runs the Louvain algorithm to optimize modularity and assign cluster IDs.

steps.title: Differential expression analysis
steps.instruction: Identify marker genes for each cluster.

substeps.instruction: Perform a non‑parametric Wilcoxon rank‑sum test between each cluster and all other cells.
Run a receiver‑operating‑characteristic (ROC) test to assess classifier power for each gene.

steps.title: Annotate cell clusters by markers
steps.instruction: Assign biological identities to clusters using known marker genes.

substeps.instruction: Label the cluster expressing KRT14, KRT5, KRT17, ACTA2, and MYLK as the myoepithelial basal (Basal) population.
Label the cluster with high KRT18, SLPI, and LTF expression as Luminal 1 (L1, luminal progenitor).
Label the cluster with high ANKRD30A, AREG, and AGR2 expression as Luminal 2 (L2, luminal mature, hormone‑responsive).
